const ms = z.string().transform((t) => Date.parse(t));
const claimedDto = z.array(
  z.object({
    id: z.string(),
    event: z.enum(["opened", "resolved", "test"]),
    eventId: z.string(),
    attempts: z.number(),
    inDoubt: z.boolean(),
    recipient: z.string(),
    workspaceId: z.string(),
    clerkOrgId: z.string(),
    createdAt: ms,
    channel: z
      .object({
        id: z.string(),
        kind: z.string(),
        audience: z.enum(["members", "address"]).nullable(),
        address: z.string().nullable(),
        chatId: z.string().nullable(),
        sealed: z.string().nullable().optional(),
      })
      .nullable(),
    why: z.enum(["channel_removed", "unsubscribed", "unconfirmed", "excluded"]).nullable(),
    stateAfter: z.string().nullable(),
    incident: z
      .object({
        id: z.string(),
        title: z.string(),
        severity: z.string(),
        openedAt: ms,
        resolvedAt: ms.nullable(),
        evidence: z.record(z.string(), z.unknown()),
      })
      .nullable(),
    monitor: z.object({ id: z.string(), name: z.string(), type: z.string() }).nullable(),
    app: z.object({ id: z.string(), name: z.string() }).nullable(),
    pageSlug: z.string().nullable(),
    parentProviderId: z.string().nullable().optional(),
    webhookBody: z.string().nullable().optional(),
    webhookStartedAt: ms.nullable().optional(),
    webhookAttempts: z.number().optional(),
  }),
);
export type Claimed = z.infer<typeof claimedDto>[number];

content.text:
Microsoft Teams would follow the Discord channel's pattern: a pasted webhook URL, stored encrypted, and posted by the sender Worker. Slack needs OAuth and the signed webhook needs a signing secret and its own retry schedule, so neither is the closest model. I only read the code, so the Teams-specific points below that come from my own knowledge are marked as such.

## Files to change or add

| # | File | Change |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | new `supabase/migrations/<timestamp>_alert_channel_teams.sql` | Add `'teams'` to the kind constraint and to the expansion function's kind list. |
| 2 | `src/lib/alerts/channel-input.ts` | Add a `teamsUrl()` validator and add `"teams"` to `channelInput`. |
| 3 | `src/lib/alerts/providers.ts` | Add `sendTeams()`. |
| 4 | `src/lib/alerts/sender.ts` | Dispatch to `sendTeams` and widen the kind checks. |
| 5 | `src/lib/model.ts` | Add `"teams"` to `ChannelKind`. |
